title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A parenthesis inside quotes is text
summary: The depth counting added in 1.42.94 read every parenthesis, including the ones inside a string or a character literal. A default value holding a closing parenthesis ended the constructor in the middle of its own parameter list.

highlights.title: val sep: String = ")"
highlights.description: That single parameter made the class lose every supertype it declares, because the quoted parenthesis was counted as the end of the header.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Parentheses inside a string or a character literal are skipped when the header is measured, escapes included. Four shapes of valid Kotlin emptied the supertype list before.
